violations.description: CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Food noted being stored not covered in walk-in freezer. Observed open boxes of frozen food items with heavy frost and ice build up above and around the open boxes.
FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Floors in the walk-in cooler and in the walk-in freezer are observed with debris build up and noted in need of cleaning.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Hot holding cabinet next to deep fryers has heavy build up on underside of unit. Shelving areas above sandwich assembly areas have heavy debris build up.
TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES (1 pts): Walk in freezer noted with no thermometer.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Shelving and equipment exteriors noted not clean. Observed debris build up on undersides of hot holding bays and on door handles of coolers/freezers.
TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES (1 pts): Freezers near deep frying area walk in freezer and walk in cooler noted with no thermometer.
